integrity: All stated counts are exact finite enumerations with standalone alternative implementation and independent polynomial/point-count checks. No claim of outside certification or independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Counts weight fixed-coordinate quintic equations, not abstract isomorphism classes; conclusions are over F_2 only. Published complete genus-six census supplies the underlying curve domain, while joint Cartier/Frobenius statistics and two explicit same-zeta/different-a witnesses are separately computed here. Priority risk from derivative computations on published datasets remains. Computer-assisted exact proofs, no independent audit.
title: Exact Cartier and Frobenius strata of binary smooth plane quintics
